prompts.icons: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: unified menu illustration atlas for ten educational games. Create one tall portrait image with an EXACT seamless 2 column by 5 row grid of TEN distinct rectangular wide landscape illustrations, equal cells, edge-to-edge art in each cell, absolutely NO gutters, labels, words, numbers, borders or watermarks. Art is premium polished colorful 3D storybook game illustration, consistent soft cinematic lighting and confident readable silhouettes, suitable for school pupils. Row1 left: two small original blue and green propeller airplanes racing toward a sunny island airfield. Row1 right: original friendly martial arts girl and boy facing each other in a training courtyard, no real franchise. Row2 left: two blue and coral stone cannon towers on mountain terrace. Row2 right: two original neon teal and violet robot duelists in futuristic arena. Row3 left: lush stone garden maze with two explorer characters and archway exit seen from above. Row3 right: two beautiful red and cyan racing cars speeding on a top-down racetrack, no brands. Row4 left: enchanted welcoming forest with three branching dirt paths and small wooden signs and explorer, signs blank. Row4 right: two original young adventurers running along three obstacle lanes through floating garden ruins, rear view, no franchise. Row5 left: original turquoise clockwork owl flying between wooden workshop fortresses with spring launcher, inventor valley. Row5 right: two beautiful teal and coral skyscrapers under construction with a yellow crane lifting a floor module, evening city. Each cell contains one complete self-contained composition with central subjects and breathing room. Keep all ten cells EXACTLY aligned as 2x5 atlas. No text anywhere. Tall portrait overall composition, cell aspect about 1.6:1.
prompts.kit: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent sprite atlas for a competitive skyscraper building game. Exact 3 columns by 2 rows, six separate objects centered in equal cells with generous transparent margins. Row1: left a front-facing rectangular modern teal glass skyscraper floor module, straight orthographic facade, three wide lit windows, cream concrete sides, no roof; center same floor module coral brick with warm lit windows; right broad dark stone skyscraper foundation podium, straight front facade. Row2: left yellow construction crane hook with cable, front view; center friendly original construction worker woman wearing a teal hard hat, full body front three-quarter view; right friendly original construction worker man wearing coral hard hat, full body front three-quarter view. Beautiful premium 3D storybook game rendering, crisp material textures, readable small silhouettes, consistent warm soft lighting. Floors must be wide and flat horizontal rectangular units that can stack seamlessly, window facade front view NOT isometric. No text, letters, numbers, logos, shadows on background, extra props, labels or dividers. TRUE transparent background.
prompts.background: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: wide background for two-player educational skyscraper construction game. Beautiful original evening city building site, warm peach and lavender sky over distant modern skyline, subtle construction cranes at far left and right edges, textured plaza ground at lower 15%, distant park trees and river, polished premium 3D storybook painting. Main middle 75% is quiet open sky with subtle clouds so two dynamically stacked towers are clearly visible. Eye-level straight facade camera. No foreground towers, no people, no text, no logo, no UI. Wide horizontal landscape.

transparent_atlas_cleanup: Edit target: the attached six-object construction sprite atlas. Remove ONLY the entire colored fog, gray/black background, glow, drop shadows and all environmental haze around the six isolated objects, leaving genuine alpha=0 transparent pixels outside their crisp silhouettes. Preserve exactly the same image dimensions 1536x1024, positions, sizes, appearance and 3-column/2-row layout of all six objects: teal floor, coral floor, dark foundation, yellow crane hook and cable, woman worker, man worker. The first row floors must remain crisp and front-facing, all windows and interior detail unchanged. The second row people remain fully intact including feet. Do not add anything. No background, no checkerboard painted in. True transparent PNG cutouts.
